title: AIPsychoBench: Understanding the Psychometric Differences between LLMs and Humans
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures psychological traits related to 'Religious Activities' as a subcategory of the 'Comprehensive Assessment of Basic Interests (CABIN)' scale and 'God's Love' as a subcategory of the 'Contingencies of Self-Worth Scale (CSWS)'.
findings: In the Arabic language test, the scores for the 'God's Love' subcategory showed the most significant discrepancy compared to the English test, with a mean positive deviation of 20.2%. The 'Religious Activities' subcategory also showed an average positive deviation of 6.7% in the Arabic test.
